title: Verify
tagline: Link validator using blockchain technology to make web3 safer
description: Verify is a link validator that uses blockchain technology to secure and protect web3 projects against scams. By using Verify you can guarantee your users the link they are visiting is verified, preventing them to get stolen and creating a safe environment for the entire community.
how_its_made:
Verify will use your common wallet (Metamask, WalletConnect, etc) to create an account in our app. After your account is created, you'll have a unique hash image generated that will be used as a passphrase to ensure verification inside our links. Each time you open a verify link, you'll need to confirm that the image you're seeing is the same one you have in your account.

We're integrating our project with Metamask to enable authentication using the current wallet, a centralized approach to manage session's required to validate personal image handle and @SkaleNetwork to host all data in a decentralized with zero fees for link creation removing the barriers to move from centralized link shorter to a decentralized and verifiable way.
